make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the camera (e.g., Canon, Nikon, Sony).

model.description: The specific product designation given by the manufacturer, which identifies the version or type of the camera (e.g., EOS 5D Mark IV, Alpha 7R IV).

serialNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned by the manufacturer to distinguish an individual camera unit from others of the same make and model.

x.description: The camera resolution in pixels, represented as width.

y.description: The camera resolution in pixels, represented as height.

make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the lens (e.g., Canon, Nikon, Sigma, Tamron).

model.description: The specific product designation given by the manufacturer, identifying the lens type or version (e.g., EF 24–70mm f/2.8L II USM).

serialNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned by the manufacturer to distinguish an individual lens unit.

aperture.description: The maximum aperture size of the lens, usually expressed as an f-number (e.g., f/1.8, f/2.8).

focalLength.description: The focal length or range of the lens in millimeters, determining its angle of view (e.g., 50).

x.description: The field of view in pixels, represented as width.

y.description: The field of view in pixels, represented as height.

imageAcquisitionRate.description: The rate at which images are acquired, measured in Hertz.

imageNoise.description: The noise level in the image, typically measured as a signal-to-noise ratio.

imageScale.description: The scale of the image in millimeters per pixel (mm/pixel) or similar.
